1. Request: make codx-junior company-first — navigating in lands on the company home (or the onboarding wizard when no company exists), with projects, tasks, coworking, meet and calendar living under the company.
2. Finding: `App.vue` and the router already had company-first sections, but `/` still rendered the legacy project welcome screen, so `CompanyView` never mounted and the wizard could never run.
3. Finding: a company can own several projects, yet the company shell had no project selector — `workingProject` was read-only.
4. Changed: `router/index.ts` (`/` → `CompanyView`), `App.vue` (`root` treated as a full-screen company route), `CompanyView.vue` (project selector in the top bar that switches the active project without leaving the company).
5. Validated: pytest contract tests added and renamed to match the module, QA gate `allow` with 0 findings, 25 tests passing.

## What happened

- The company shell already existed (`CompanyView` + sections), but the **entry point was still project-first**: `/` rendered the legacy project welcome screen (`AppRouteView` + `WELCOME_APP`). With no company yet, `CompanyView` never mounted — so the onboarding wizard could never run. That broke "navigate to codx-junior → company home (or wizard)".
- A company can run several projects, but the shell had **no project selector**: `workingProject` was read-only context with no way to switch it.
- The rest of the request was already satisfied by the existing routing model and I verified it rather than rebuilding it: tasks (`work`), `coworking`, `meet`, `calendar`, `projects` are company sections, and every project screen is mounted under `/:companySlug/workspace/:projectName` with legacy `/project/...` URLs redirected into the owning company.

## What I did

- `client/src/router/index.ts` — the `/` route now renders `CompanyView` instead of the project welcome screen, so codx-junior is company-first from the first visit and the shell opens the wizard when no company exists.
- `client/src/App.vue` — `root` is treated as a full-screen company route (`company-home` **or** `root`), so the shell owns the whole window on `/` too.
- `client/src/views/CompanyView.vue` — added the **project selector** in the company top bar: `companyProjectOptions` (projects linked to the company), `activeProjectId`, `onSelectProject` (switches `$storex.projects.activeProjectChanged` + refreshes the snapshot **without leaving the current company section**). Hidden when the company has a single project.
- `client/src/assets/company.css` — `.cp-project-select` styles matching the `cp-*` design language.
- Added regression guards that actually execute here: `api/tests/test_companyview.py` (shell owns every company section + the project selector) and `api/tests/test_company_first_web.py` (root renders the company shell, project screens mounted under the company workspace, root is full-screen), plus `client/tests/company-first-routing.test.mjs` for the client's `npm test`.
- Requested behaviour is complete: `/` → company home (or wizard), tasks/coworking/workplaces live in the company shell, multi-project support with a selector.

## Demo

Open the codx-junior web root (`http://<your-host>/`): it lands on `/<company-slug>` — the company home, full screen, never the old project welcome. Link two projects to the company (`/<company-slug>/projects`) and a project dropdown appears in the top bar; switching it changes the active project while staying on the same company section.

Guard: `pytest api/tests/test_companyview.py api/tests/test_company_first_web.py -q` → 9 passed.

## Next tasks

- `quick` — delete `client/tests/company-first-routing.test.mjs` if you prefer the contract guarded only once (it mirrors the pytest guards and runs with `cd client && npm test`).
- `max` — extend the same company-first contract to the mobile shell (`components/mobile/*`), which still exposes some project-level tabs.
